name: Shilin Official Residence
scope: The main Shilin Official Residence building and its physically connected wings, including the covered entry and the immediate driveway loop.
era: The standing main house, with the historic entrance details visible in the 2006 public-domain photograph and the restoration described by Taipei.

references.caption: Shilin Residence of Chiang Kai-shek, Taipei, Republic of China.
references.alt: Shilin Residence of Chiang Kai-shek, Taipei, Republic of China.

originalReview.notes: Shows the blue-green woodwork, gray flat-profile tiled roof, two visible round driveway columns with pale stone bases, dark shallow porch eaves, windows behind the portico, and the shallow level change toward the house.

review.method: Exact published Qualla original with native photographer release
review.notes: The public-domain Jiang façade photo already on Qualla matches the source bytes and the creator’s own-work release. The second verified Jiang photo depicts a palm-lined driveway and is contextual. Attribution-bearing images were excluded.
